items.says: monoflake/driver's release publishes the build a run already rehearsed, named by its run id, and refuses a hash not recorded, ending the second build of driver-single-build
A driver's description reports the interface versions it implements, and the control refuses a driver outside the range it speaks

The driver writes a per-deployment egress map into the machine's filter, from each deployment's `network`, adding it as the deployment deploys and removing it as it deletes, elements only and never a rule
driver(cloudflare) adopts `object` and `database` as it adopts `function`, which management.res answers beyond_host until the D1 wiring lands
`{app}.b{binding}` is admitted only where a deployment declares it, not for every deployment

holds.owes: the entry admitting declared names alone
